notes.notes: Fixes of some bugs related to menus and interface of the game and the control of the game with keyboard and mouse.

notes.title: The Five Covens - Available NOW !
notes.notes:
Hello.

The entire team at rBornGames are delighted to announce that our game The Five Covens is available on the Steam store starting today.

The Five Covens was a game developed by a small team of students, originally for the PlayStation platform. Since its departure we have been working on bringing the game to Steam, finally here it is available for you to play.

We hope you enjoy the game and have fun with it.

Regards, rBornGames.
